paragraphs: Abba Elazar; Abba Elazar ben Gomel; Abba Elazar ben Diglai or Dulai; Abba Antoli; Abba Binyamin. See each under his own entry, for Abba here is simply an honorific.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Abba is described as an honorific; the text does not say these figures can be found only under particular entries.

Hyman describes Abba as an honorific in this list and directs readers to the individual entries. This is retained as his explanation of the listed forms, without making an exhaustive rule about every Abba occurrence or joining the listed people to one identity.
